kv.description: Wastewater generated from campus non-potable uses; baseline freshwater intake tracked via WFD-M001.
Influent collected and equalized before treatment; baseline municipal discharge tracked via WFD-M002.
Integrated MBR + RO + UV system producing reuse-grade water; electricity logged via plant energy meter.
Buffer storage and distribution manifold for treated water prior to end-use.
Treated water reused across cooling towers, landscaping irrigation, and toilet flushing as per reuse split.
Any reject/brine + residual non-reused volume discharged to municipal network; reduction credited by lower discharge vs baseline.
